item.title: 208 mil reproducciones · 41 mil reacciones | It’s not about race, it’s about ethnicity. I believe everyone should be able to have communities/countries of people of their own ethnic background that are for them. Nigerians get their own community. Indians get their own community. Chinese get their own community. And that means Germanic people, Nordic people, Celtic people etc. (white European ethnicities) also get their own place. They share a common language, common religion, a common culture, common values, and a common heritage. All “race” problems would be solved in a day if we organized in this way. Why is it racist to say all these other people can have their own place to live just for them with their own people and traditions, but if I want my own with my own people it’s an ethnostate? Because my skin is white? Being “white” does not even accurately represent all of the different cultures in European history, and my Germanic ethnicity is not the same as a Turkish ethnicity for example. I should have every right to a Germanic home that is for Germanic people just as much as the Indian has India, the Albanian has Albania, the Ghanaian has Ghana, or the Japanese has Japan. I want to live with and around people who have the same language, values, culture, and religion as me, not people who I have nothing in common with. Different cultures have different beauties about them that make them unique. I enjoy visiting them and learning about them. But they are not mine, and they never will be, and I do not want them in my home. | Will Witt
